clips.title: The story
paras: At the bridge west of Eastvale Logging Camp, Guard Thomas watches Elwynn’s eastern frontier. The Stormwind soldier guards local workers from wild predators and murlocs.

At the stone bridge over the river toward Eastvale Logging Camp, Guard Thomas holds a quiet but exposed post. The woods around him shelter aggressive creatures, and the logging workers depend on the Stormwind guard for protection. With the army stretched thin, Thomas must rely on travelers to help keep order and carry messages to central command.
